meta.name: flowio
meta.description: Read, inspect, and write Flow Cytometry Standard (FCS) 2.0, 3.0, and 3.1 files with FlowIO. Use for low-level FCS metadata and channel inspection, NumPy event extraction, multi-dataset files, table export, and FCS 3.1 creation; use FlowKit for compensation, cytometry transforms, gating, or FlowJo workspaces.

copy.tagline_en: Read, inspect, and write Flow Cytometry FCS files
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to work with FCS files from flow cytometry experiments

howto.what: 该技能让 Claude 能够读取、检查并写入 FCS 2.0/3.0/3.1 流式细胞术标准文件:提取事件数据为 NumPy 数组,读取文件元数据与通道信息,导出 CSV/DataFrame,并可从数组创建 FCS 3.1 文件。
howto.when: 当用户要求解析 FCS 文件、提取流式细胞术事件数据、检查通道或元数据、转换 CSV、创建 FCS 3.1 文件等低层操作时触发;补偿、门控等高级分析建议改用 FlowKit。

howto.what_en: Enables reading, inspecting, and writing FCS 2.0/3.0/3.1 files: extract events as NumPy arrays, read metadata and channel info, export CSV/DataFrame, and create FCS 3.1 files from arrays.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to parse FCS files, extract flow cytometry events, inspect channels/metadata, export CSV, or create FCS 3.1 / multi-dataset files; for compensation, gating, or FlowJo workspaces, recommend FlowKit.
